reported.quote: The credit cost for Q3 FY26 stood at INR 343 Crore, which includes INR 59 Crore due to accelerated write-off and INR 37 Crore due to additional impact due to increase in ECL rates.
PAR 90 stood at 2.94%, GNPA of 4.04% and net NPA of 1.36%, both predominantly measured at 60 DPD.
PAT doubled QoQ to INR 252 Crore, while adjusted figures stood at INR 266 Crore, translating to an ROA and ROE of 3.5% and 13.8%, respectively.

Net interest income grew 13.4% YoY to INR 977 Crore with portfolio yield of 21.0% versus 20.7% in Q2 FY26.
Cost-to-income ratio stood at 34.1%, and adjusted figure at 32.3%, excluding the labour code impact.

guidance.quote: Our FY27 credit cost guidance of 4% to 4.5% reflects a new PAR 15 accretion rate of 30-35 bps per month.
